title: Feed imports
intro: Your property feeds and the history of every import run: how many items were read, imported and refused, and why.
noRuns: This feed has not run yet.
itemErrors: Refused items of the run started {date}
itemErrorsCapped: Only the first {kept} of {failed} refused items are kept.

runErrors.FEED_DESTINATION_BLOCKED: The feed address (or a redirect) points to a private or internal network.
runErrors.FEED_FETCH_FAILED: The feed could not be downloaded.
runErrors.FEED_HTTP_STATUS: The feed server refused the request.
runErrors.FEED_TIMEOUT: The feed took too long to download.
runErrors.FEED_TOO_LARGE: The feed is larger than allowed.
runErrors.FEED_CONTENT_TYPE: The address did not return a feed in the expected format.
runErrors.FEED_DTD_NOT_ALLOWED: The feed declares a DTD or entities, which are refused for security.
runErrors.FEED_MALFORMED: The feed is not well-formed XML.
runErrors.FEED_CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN: This feed format is no longer available.
runErrors.FEED_LEASE_EXPIRED: The import stopped unexpectedly; it will run again at the next scheduled time.
runErrors.FEED_NEVER_STARTED: The import did not start in time.
runErrors.FEED_NO_OWNER: No active member of your agency can own the imported listings. Ask an admin to check the team.
runErrors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side.
runErrors.FEED_MAPPING_INVALID: The mapping profile of this feed is missing or no longer valid. Open the mapper and save it again.
runErrors.FEED_PAUSED_VOLUME_SPIKE: Paused: the feed suddenly had far more listings than usual. Nothing past that point was imported.
runErrors.FEED_PAUSED_MASS_WITHDRAWAL: Paused: a large share of the feed's listings vanished at once. Nothing was withdrawn.
runErrors.FEED_PAUSED_EMPTY_FEED: Paused: the feed was empty or none of its listings could be imported, while this feed still has live listings. Nothing was withdrawn.
runErrors.FEED_CONNECTION_PAUSED: The feed is paused; resume it to import again.

notices.queued: The run was queued; it starts in a moment.
notices.created: The feed was connected; its first import starts shortly.
notices.resumed: The feed was resumed; its next import starts shortly.

errors.generic: We could not load your feeds. Please try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.FEED_RUN_ACTIVE: A run of this feed is already waiting or running.
errors.FEED_URL_NOT_ALLOWED: This address is not allowed (private or internal networks are refused).
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this feed. Reload and try again.
errors.FEED_CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN: This feed format is not available.
errors.FEED_MAPPING_REQUIRED: Choose a mapping profile for a generic XML feed.
errors.FEED_MAPPING_INVALID: This mapping profile is not valid for this feed format.

form.intro: Choose the format and paste the address of your feed. Listings are imported on the schedule you choose; values we cannot match to our locations, types or features hold the listing as a draft until our team maps them.
form.name: Name
form.urlHint: An http or https address. Feeds on private or internal networks are refused.

credTypes.query: An access key in the address
credTypes.header: An access key sent as a header

form.credentialsHint: Access details are stored encrypted and never shown again. Fill the fields that fit your choice.
form.countryHint: Kyero feeds do not state a country. Leave empty for Spain.
form.profileHint: Generic XML feeds need the profile you saved in the mapper.

mapper.open: Map a feed or a spreadsheet
mapper.title: Map a feed or a spreadsheet
mapper.intro: Connect any XML export, or import a CSV or Excel file, without code: read a sample, pick where each listing field lives in it, check the result and save the mapping. Feeds are imported once you connect them with the saved profile; a file is imported when you press the button at the end.
mapper.sampleHint: Upload an XML, CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file, or give the address of an XML feed. For a feed only the first {mb} MB are read.
mapper.fromUrl: Or the address of the feed
mapper.detected: The feed repeats the element {element}; {count} of them are in the sample.
mapper.truncated: The sample was cut at the size limit.
mapper.step3: 3. Where does each field come from?
mapper.fieldsHint: Pick the path in the sample for each field. The values found there are shown below the picker. Only the reference and the property type are required.
mapper.constant: A fixed text for every listing
mapper.translate: Translate the words of the feed into ours ({values}).
mapper.needRequired: Pick the reference and the property type to see the listings.
mapper.dryRunHint: Shows what an import of the sample would do, without writing anything: which listings would be created or updated, held as drafts or refused, and which locations, types or features we cannot match yet.

report.summary: {total} listings read: {created} would be created, {updated} updated, {held} held as drafts, {refused} refused.
report.unmatchedHint: Our team maps these; listings that use them are held as drafts until then.

mapper.saveHint: After saving you connect the feed with this profile and choose how often it is imported.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Only agency admins can map feeds.
errors.FEED_URL_NOT_ALLOWED: This address is not allowed (private or internal networks are refused).
errors.FEED_SAMPLE_INVALID: This file cannot be read as a feed or a spreadsheet.
errors.FEED_MAPPING_INVALID: The mapping is not valid yet. Check the paths and the required fields.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many samples at once. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than the sample limit.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: Send the file as XML, CSV or Excel.

reason.NOT_XML: The file does not start like an XML document.
reason.NO_RECORDS: No repeating listing element was found.
reason.DOCTYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: Documents with a DTD or entities are refused for security.
reason.CONTENT_TYPE: The address did not return XML.
reason.HTTP_401: The feed asked for a login.
reason.NOT_SHEET: This is not a CSV or Excel file.
reason.NOT_TEXT: The file is binary, not a text CSV. Save it as CSV or Excel (.xlsx).
reason.UNSUPPORTED_XLS: Old .xls files and password-protected workbooks cannot be read. Save it as .xlsx or CSV.
reason.BAD_ZIP: The Excel file is damaged or not an .xlsx file.
reason.ZIP_BOMB: The Excel file is too large once unpacked.
reason.NO_SHEET: The workbook has no visible sheet.
reason.TOO_MANY_ROWS: The file has too many rows.
reason.TOO_MANY_COLUMNS: The file has too many columns.
reason.CELL_TOO_LARGE: A cell holds too much text.
reason.TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than the limit.
reason.FILE_GONE: The uploaded file is no longer available. Upload it again.

errors.FEED_RUN_ACTIVE: An import of this file is already running. Wait until it ends.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: This connection was changed by someone else. Reload and try again.

mapper.sheetHint: A CSV or Excel file is read from its first row, which must hold the column names; only the first sheet is read, up to {mb} MB, {rows} rows and {columns} columns. Formulas are read as the values Excel saved. Spreadsheet text is never run as a formula.
mapper.detectedSheet: The file has {columns} columns with values; the first {count} rows are in the sample.
mapper.importSheetHint: The import runs in the background. You will see each row that could not be imported, with the reason, on the next page.

paused.title: Import paused on {date}
paused.VOLUME_SPIKE: The last import read {items} listings; this feed usually has about {typical}.
paused.MASS_WITHDRAWAL: {missing} of your {live} listings from this feed were missing from the last import.
paused.EMPTY_FEED: The last import found no listing it could import ({items} read); you have {live} live listings from this feed.

explain.VOLUME_SPIKE: We stopped before importing the extra listings, in case the feed sends someone else's portfolio or duplicates.
explain.MASS_WITHDRAWAL: We withdrew nothing: a feed losing this many listings at once is usually a broken export, not sales.
explain.EMPTY_FEED: We withdrew nothing: an empty feed is usually a broken export or a wrong address, not a sold-out portfolio. Check the feed, then resume.

paused.acceptChange: The change is real (import it as it is)
paused.adminOnly: Only agency admins can resume a feed. Without "the change is real", the next import is checked again.
